values: 召唤强大的卡莱尔先生协助作战。
Cecia summons Mr. Carlyle to assist in the battle.

选择一个格子，在该位置唤醒卡莱尔先生协助作战。卡莱尔先生继承100%英雄属性，普通攻击对面前1格扇形范围内的所有敌人造成170% + 12% ATK伤害，且最大生命值额外提高45%，但每秒失去4%最大生命值。被召唤时，卡莱尔先生会释放“苦痛缚身”：对周围2格内所有敌人施加缠绕，被缠绕的目标无法行动，且每秒受到140% ATK伤害，持续2秒。再次使用本技能时，若卡莱尔先生已在场上，则使其回复至满血，并再次释放“苦痛缚身”。

Cecia summons Mr. Carlyle to a selected tile to assist. Mr. Carlyle inherits all of Cecia's stats and his normal attack deals 170% + 12% ATK damage to enemies within a 1-tile arc. He gains an extra 45% max HP but loses 4% of max HP per second. When Mr. Carlyle is summoned, he initiates Tangled Agony to entangle enemies within 2 tiles, dealing 140% ATK damage per second for 2s. The entangled enemies cannot move or act. If Mr. Carlyle is already on the battlefield when this skill is used again, the skill restores his HP to Max, allowing him to cast the Tangled Agony again.
卡莱尔先生的最大生命值额外提高60%。
Mr. Carlyle's max HP is increased by an extra 60%.
卡莱尔先生的普通攻击伤害提高至175% + 12% ATK。
Mr. Carlyle's normal attack deals 175% + 12% ATK damage.
卡莱尔先生的普通攻击伤害提高至180% + 12% ATK。
Mr. Carlyle's normal attack deals 180% + 12% ATK damage.
卡莱尔先生的普通攻击伤害提高至185% + 12% ATK。
Mr. Carlyle's normal attack deals 185% + 12% ATK damage.
提升自身和卡莱尔先生的攻击速度。
Increases Cecia and Mr. Carlyle's ATK SPD.
从大地中汲取力量，使自己和卡莱尔先生的攻击速度提升45 + 5点，持续8秒。
Cecia gains power from the earth to increase her and Mr. Carlyle's ATK SPD by 45 + 5 for 8s.
释放该技能后，卡莱尔先生的下一次普通攻击会替换为撼地锤击，对其周围2格内的所有敌人造成320% ATK伤害，该伤害额外获得15点生命汲取。
Mr. Carlyle's next normal attack will be replaced with Thundering Quake, dealing 320% ATK damage to all surrounding enemies within 2 tiles and gaining 15 Life Drain.
普通攻击每隔几次就会获得一次伤害增强。
Cecia deals enormous damage every few normal attacks.
被动地，瑟西娅与卡莱尔先生获得20 + 2点防御穿透。每当瑟西娅累计进行3次普通攻击，自己的下一次普通攻击将获得强化，伤害提高至220% ATK。
Passive. Cecia and Mr. Carlyle gain 20 + 2 DEF Penetration. Cecia's next normal attack is enhanced after she uses 3 normal attacks, dealing 220% ATK damage.
被动获得的防御穿透提高至25 + 2点。
Cecia's DEF Penetration gained from the passive effect is increased to 25 + 2.
强化后的普通攻击伤害提高至225% ATK。
The enhanced normal attack deals 225% ATK damage.
强化后的普通攻击伤害提高至230% ATK。
The enhanced normal attack deals 230% ATK damage.
提高自身攻击速度，卡莱尔先生在场上存在期间进一步提升攻击速度。
Cecia's ATK SPD increases during battle. She gains extra ATK SPD with Mr. Carlyle's presence.
战斗中，自身提高15点攻击速度。且卡莱尔先生在场上存在期间，额外提升9点攻击速度。
Cecia increases her ATK SPD by 15. She gains an extra 9 ATK SPD while Mr. Carlyle is on the battlefield.
战斗中，自身提高20点攻击速度。且卡莱尔先生在场上存在期间，额外提升12点攻击速度。
Cecia increases her ATK SPD by 20. She gains an extra 12 ATK SPD while Mr. Carlyle is on the battlefield.
战斗中，自身提高25点攻击速度。且卡莱尔先生在场上存在期间，额外提升15点攻击速度。
Cecia increases her ATK SPD by 25. She gains an extra 15 ATK SPD while Mr. Carlyle is on the battlefield.
缠绕目标，并从目标身上吸取属性值。
Cecia entangles an enemy and absorbs stats from the target.
对一名敌人施加强力缠绕，被缠绕的目标无法行动，且每秒受到60% ATK伤害，持续4秒。自身每秒会从受该技能影响的目标身上永久吸取1.5%的护甲与魔抗，并与卡莱尔先生共享吸取到的属性值。对于每个目标，最多只能通过该方式吸取8次属性值，该技能会优先对不处于免疫控制状态、且吸取次数还未达到上限的敌人使用。

Cecia entangles an enemy with reinforced Thorns, dealing 60% ATK damage every second and the target cannot move or act for 4s. Cecia absorbs 1.5% of Phys DEF and Magic DEF from the target every second. The absorbed stats last until the battle ends and are also shared by Mr. Carlyle. Cecia can only absorb each target up to 8 times. This skill prioritizes enemies who have not reached the limit and are not in the control immunity status.
每次吸取属性时，还会同时吸取目标1点受愈。
Absorbs 1 of the target's Vitality each time when stealing stats.
被缠绕的目标，每秒受到的伤害提高至70% ATK。
Increases the entangled targets' damage taken per second to 70% ATK.
被缠绕的目标，每秒受到的伤害提高至80% ATK。
Increases the entangled targets' damage taken per second to 80% ATK.
技能“钻心利刺”触发所需的普通攻击次数降低。
The required normal attacks to trigger Agonizing Puncture is reduced.
技能“钻心利刺”触发所需的普通攻击次数降低-1次。
Reduces the required normal attacks to trigger Agonizing Puncture by -1.
获得500点初始能量。释放终极技能时，将会每秒永久吸取被缠绕敌人2%的基础属性，至多偷取相当于自身对应初始属性的50%，并与卡莱尔先生共享吸取到的属性值。

Cecia gains 500 initial Energy. When she casts her Ultimate, she permanently steals 2% of basic stats every second from entangled enemies. The amount stolen for each stat cannot exceed 50% of Cecia's initial value for that stat. Cecia shares all stolen stats with Mr. Carlyle.
